cancellationRefund.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellationRefund.intro: At People & Places, we pride ourselves on curating immersive, high-quality experiences in Ghana. To ensure clarity and fairness to all our travelers and our local partners, we have established the following refunds and cancellation policy.

sections.heading: If you cancel a package trip
sections.intro: All bookings for our Just Go Ghana packages are subject to the following cancellation timeline. The initial $400 deposit is non-refundable and non-transferable in all cases.

items.term: 60 or more days before the trip
items.text: You will receive a full refund of all payments made, minus the $400 non-refundable deposit.
You will receive a 50% refund of the total trip cost, excluding the deposit.

items.term: 30 days or less before the trip
items.text: No refund will be issued. A 100% cancellation fee applies.
Travelers who do not arrive for the trip, or who leave early for any reason, are not eligible for a refund.

sections.heading: If you cancel a day tour
sections.intro: Day tours are paid in full when you book, rather than with a deposit and a balance. They are shorter, lower-priced and often booked at short notice, so the timeline is simpler.

items.term: 48 hours or more before the tour
items.text: You will receive a full refund of everything you have paid.

items.term: Less than 48 hours before the tour
items.text: No refund can be issued. By that point your guide is booked and your places at each site are held.
Travellers who do not arrive for a day tour are treated the same as a cancellation inside 48 hours.

sections.heading: Changing or rescheduling a booking
sections.intro: We understand that life happens. We offer the following options to help accommodate changes to your plans.

items.text: You may request to reschedule your trip dates up to 45 days before your scheduled arrival. Requests are subject to availability and current hotel rates.
A strictly administrative fee of $150 may apply to process date changes, plus any difference in package price for the new dates.
Requests made less than 30 days before the arrival date generally cannot be accommodated, because of vendor contracts already in place.

sections.heading: If we cancel
sections.intro: In the unlikely event that People & Places must cancel a tour due to unforeseen circumstances such as political instability or natural disasters, or for reasons beyond our control, we will offer you the following options.

items.text: Move your full credit to a future trip date or a different available package.
Receive a full refund of all payments made, including the deposit.

We strongly recommend purchasing comprehensive travel insurance that includes Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) coverage. This protects you against financial loss if you must cancel due to illness, flight delays, or work conflicts.

People & Places reserves the right to slightly alter tour routes or accommodations without prior notice where necessary, for example due to weather or road maintenance. Any changes will be of equal or greater value.
People & Places shall not be liable for any loss, damage, injury, or illness caused in any way to participants while using third-party services such as hotels, transport, and attractions.
Guests are expected to conduct themselves respectfully toward staff, fellow travelers, and locals. Behavior deemed disruptive or disrespectful may result in removal from the tour without a refund.

cancellationRefund.contactIntro: If you have any questions, or need to request a cancellation or a change, please contact us immediately in writing.
cancellationRefund.closing: By booking with People & Places, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to this cancellation and refund policy.

travelInsurance.title: Travel Insurance
travelInsurance.intro: Travel insurance is required on every People & Places trip. We ask for proof of cover before you travel, and we will not be able to take you on the trip without it. This page explains exactly what your policy needs to include and when we need to see it.

sections.heading: What your policy must cover
sections.intro: Any comprehensive travel insurance policy will do, as long as it includes both of the following. Cover levels vary widely, so read your policy rather than assuming.

items.text: Emergency medical treatment, personal injury, hospital care, and the cost of medical evacuation or repatriation, including air ambulance. This is the part that matters most, and the part cheap policies most often leave out.

Trip cancellation, trip delay, missed departures, and lost or delayed baggage. Cancellation cover is usually the only way to recover money you have already paid us that our own cancellation terms cannot refund.
Check that your policy covers everything your trip includes. Hiking, boat and canoe trips, quad biking and similar activities are excluded by some policies unless you add them.

sections.heading: When we need to see it

items.term: Proof is due 30 days before you travel
items.text: Send us your policy number, your insurer's name, and the dates your cover runs. Email or WhatsApp is fine. This is the same deadline as your final balance, so the two can be sent together.

items.term: Buy it when you book, not when it is due
items.text: Cancellation cover only protects what you buy it before. A policy bought a month before departure will not cover something that has already happened.

items.term: If we do not receive it
items.text: We will chase you for it. If we still do not have proof by your departure date, we cannot take you on the trip, and the cancellation terms apply as they would to any other cancellation.

sections.heading: What is your responsibility
sections.intro: We are not insurance brokers and we cannot advise you on which policy to buy. What we can tell you is what to check before you buy.

items.text: Cover, exclusions and claim limits are set by your insurer, not by us. You are responsible for making sure the policy you buy actually covers your trip, your activities and any medical condition you already have.
Claims are made to your insurer, not to us. We will give you whatever documentation we hold, such as booking confirmations and written accounts of what happened, to support a claim.

items.term: Cover for people you book for
items.text: If you are booking for a family or a group, everyone travelling needs their own cover, and you are responsible for confirming they have it.

travelInsurance.contactIntro: If you are unsure whether a policy meets these requirements, send us the details before you buy and we will tell you what looks missing.
